title: Introduction to Python
content: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its simplicity and readability. Created by Guido van Rossum in 1991, it has become one of the most popular languages.

title: Data Structures 101
content: Data structures are fundamental concepts in computer science. Common structures include arrays, linked lists, trees, and graphs. Each has specific use cases and performance characteristics.

title: Cloud Computing Basics
content: Cloud computing delivers computing services over the internet. Major providers include AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Benefits include scalability, cost-efficiency, and accessibility.
